AURORA — green-and-violet curtains ripple through bare birch branches, casting shifting emerald light across the snow, each drift briefly tinted rose then gold as the ribbons turn.
LOW GOLD SUN — a honey-gold winter sun rakes long amber light across the drifts, gilding every frost-crystal and warming the deep blue shadows pooled between the trees.
BLUE-HOUR — deep periwinkle dusk settles softly over the snowfield as the first warm fae-lights glimmer awake among the birches, amber sparks against the cold blue air.
MOONLIT SNOW — a bright full moon silvers the crystalline snow, every surface softly luminous, the whole grove glowing with a cool blue-white radiance edged in pale gold.
PALE ROSE DAWN — first pink light washes the frost-feathered branches in warm blush, the snow blushing rose beneath a sky still threading pale violet and soft gold.
STARLIT FROST — a clear cold star-field blazes overhead while frost-motes drift and catch the starlight, each crystal sparked gold and silver against the deep blue dark below.
